name: Kagami no Naka no Orgel - Futatsume no Monogatari [Snow White]
original_name: 鏡の中のオルゴール　ふたつめの物語 [SNOW WHITE]
source:
Fantasy on Snow White fairy-tale. Imagine that Snow White is not expelled from the castle, but confined inside it for improper practices.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
对《白雪公主》童话的另一种幻想：假如白雪公主并未被逐出城堡，而是因不当行径遭到软禁……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
